questions.scenario: Two brothers are watching sports on TV.
questions.question:
Older brother: Look at the player! Can you run like him?
Younger brother: ___________________
options: No, I can't. I am too slow.
No, I am not. I am too slow.
Yes, I can. I am too slow.
Yes, I do. I am too slow.
questions.explanation: 因為回答『我太慢了』，所以不可能做到，必須以否定句簡答。問句用 Can you...?，否定短答為 No, I can't.。選項 B 誤用 Be 動詞；選項 C 前後語意矛盾；選項 D 誤用助動詞 do。
questions.commonMisconception: 對於 Can 提問，被母語干擾回答 『No, I am not.』，或是沒有結合後方語意 (too slow) 判斷出必須是否定回答。

questions.scenario: A gym teacher is asking a student during class.
questions.question:
Teacher: Can you jump high, Andy?
Andy: ___________________
options: Yes, you can. Look at me
Yes, I am. Look at me!
Yes, I can. Look at me!
No, I don't. Look at me!
questions.explanation: 助動詞 Can you...? 提問，必須使用 Yes, I can.。選項 B 的 I am 和選項 D 的 I don't 都是錯誤的助動詞對應。選項 C 沒有將 you 換成 I。
questions.commonMisconception: 被口語常見的 I am 誤導，忘記在問答中需要助動詞對應。

questions.scenario: Friends are talking about a bird they see outside.
questions.question:
Sarah: The little bird has hurt wings. _______________
John: No, it can't.
questions.explanation: 從約定俗成的簡答 No, it can't. 推判問句必須以 Can 開頭且主詞為 it。選項 B 將 is 與原形動詞 fly 疊加；選項 C 用錯了助動詞 does；選項 D 主詞錯誤。
questions.commonMisconception: 無法從回答的 can't 回推問句的結構，或是在看選項時看到中文意思對就選了 Is it fly 這種錯誤句型。

questions.scenario: A magic show is happening at the park.
questions.question:
Magician: I have a magic cat. It can dance.
Boy: Wow! ___________________
questions.explanation: 男孩對於這隻貓的能力感到好奇。因為敘述句是『It can dance.』，順接去問其他能力自然該用『Can it sing...?』。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤；選項 C 語境不精準；選項 D 主詞變成問魔術師了。
questions.commonMisconception: 在對話的情境延伸中，無法繼續維持原本的話語焦點 (it / can)。

questions.scenario: Mom is asking Jimmy to reach for something on a high shelf.
questions.question:
Mom: Can you reach the book for me?
Jimmy: No, I can't. ___________________
options: I am not jump that high
questions.explanation: 前半句已說 No, I can't.，後半句解釋原因時，同樣要用表示能力的 can't。選項 B, D 錯字連篇 (am not/isn't 加動詞原形)；選項 C do not 不表能力。
questions.commonMisconception: 解釋理由時，助動詞切換錯亂，把 am not + 原形動詞當作否定句的萬靈丹。

questions.scenario: Two students are reading a comic book about superheroes.
questions.question:
Student A: The red hero is strong.
Student B: Yes, he is. Can he fly?
Student A: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句是 Can he fly?，簡答必須是 Yes, he can.。選項 B 誤用 Be 動詞；選項 C 誤用 do 助動詞；選項 D 誤用人稱代名詞 I。
questions.commonMisconception: 被前面的『Yes, he is.』對話干擾，順著口頭禪也回答『Yes, he is.』。

questions.scenario: A girl brings her new dog to the playground.
questions.question:
Jenny: Meet my new dog, Max. He is very smart.
Mark: ___________________
Jenny: Yes, he can catch a ball.
questions.explanation: Jenny 在講述這隻小狗 (Max，擬人化用 he 代表) 的才藝。回答說『Yes, he can catch...』，顯示前面 Mark 問的是能力。而主詞要用 he。選項 B 是嚴重文法錯誤；選項 D 的 it 與 Jenny 叫 he 沒對上。
questions.commonMisconception: 看見 animal 就死板板要選 it，沒注意到情境中對話對象把寵物擬人稱呼 he。

questions.scenario: During art class, a kid looks at his friend's notebook.
questions.question:
Kid A: Wow! You can draw a big robot.
Kid B: Yes, I can. ___________________
options: And I draw a car, too.
And I am draw a car, too.
And I can draw a car, too.
And you can draw a car.
questions.explanation: 接續前面的 Yes, I can. (是的，我會)，Kid B 想順勢說出自己『也會』做什麼。因此使用 can 加原形動詞是最自然的表述。選項 B 是雙動詞錯誤；選項 C 雖文法可通但缺乏助動詞的力道；選項 D 改變主詞不符邏輯。
questions.commonMisconception: 在延續長句子表達時，常常把 Be 動詞加到原形動詞前面 (I am draw...)。

questions.scenario: A brother is asking his older sister to help him with sports.
questions.question:
Brother: ___________________
Sister: No, I can't. Ask Dad for help.
questions.explanation: 從姊姊的回答『No, I can't.』可得知問句必定是以 Can you...? 開頭。選項 B 與 D 皆為 Be 動詞加原形動詞的錯誤結構。選項 C 的 Do you 在文意與回答都不匹配。
questions.commonMisconception: 沒看清楚下半句回答的提示，被中文『你打棒球嗎？』干擾而選擇 Are you。

questions.scenario: A girl is talking to a zookeeper near the penguin area.
questions.question:
Girl: Penguins have wings. Can they fly?
Zookeeper: ___________________
questions.explanation: 問句主詞是 penguins (they複數)，以 Can 提問。企鵝不會飛，所以是否定回答。正確配對為 No, they can't.。選項 B 的 aren't 動詞錯誤；選項 C, D 是前後自相矛盾的句子。
questions.commonMisconception: 答題時被『翅膀(wings)』的意象干擾而忘記基本常識，或否定時錯用 aren't 代替 can't。
